097  /**
098   * Returns a non-{@code null}, determinate {@link BeanTypeList} of {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean
099   * types} that the supplied {@link Collection} of {@link TypeMirror}s contains.
100   *
101   * <p>The returned {@link BeanTypeList} may be {@linkplain BeanTypeList#isEmpty() empty}.</p>
102   *
103   * @param types a non-{@code null} {@link Collection} of {@link TypeMirror}s
104   *
105   * @return a non-{@code null}, determinate {@link BeanTypeList} of {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean
106   * types} drawn from the supplied {@link Collection}
107   *
108   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code types} is {@code null}
109   *
110   * @see #supertypes(TypeMirror, java.util.function.Predicate)
111   */
112  public final BeanTypeList beanTypes(final Collection<? extends TypeMirror> types) {
113    return switch (types) {
114    case Collection<?> c when c.isEmpty() -> BeanTypeList.of();
115    case BeanTypeList btl -> btl;
116    case SupertypeList stl -> this.beanTypes(stl);
117    default -> {
118      int size = types.size();
119      final ArrayList<TypeMirror> newTypes = new ArrayList<>(size);
120      for (final TypeMirror t : types) {
121        if (legalBeanType(t)) {
122          newTypes.add(t);
123        }
124      }
125      if (newTypes.isEmpty()) {
126        yield BeanTypeList.of();
127      }
128      size = newTypes.size();
129      if (size > 1) {
130        newTypes.sort(Comparator.comparing(TypeMirror::getKind,
131                                           PrimitiveAndReferenceTypeKindComparator.INSTANCE)
132                      .thenComparing(new SpecializationComparator(this.domain()))
133                      .thenComparing(this::elementKind,
134                                     ClassesThenInterfacesElementKindComparator.INSTANCE)
135                      .thenComparing(Types::erasedName));
136      }
137      int interfaceIndex = -1;
138      for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
139        final ElementKind k = this.elementKind(newTypes.get(i));
140        if (k != null && k.isInterface()) {
141          interfaceIndex = i;
142          break;
143        }
144      }
145      yield BeanTypeList.of(this, newTypes, interfaceIndex, proxiable(newTypes.get(0), size));
146    }
147    };
148  }
149
150  private final BeanTypeList beanTypes(final SupertypeList stl) {
151    if (stl.isEmpty()) {
152      return BeanTypeList.of();
153    }
154    int size = stl.size();
155    int i = 0;
156    for (; i < size; i++) {
157      if (!legalBeanType(stl.get(i))) {
158        break;
159      }
160    }
161    if (i == size) {
162      // All types were legal.
163      return BeanTypeList.of(this, stl, -1, proxiable(stl.get(0), size));
164    }
165    // At least one type was illegal. Start copying.
166    final ArrayList<TypeMirror> newTypes = new ArrayList<>(size);
167    for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
168      newTypes.add(stl.get(j)); // the type is known to be legal
169    }
170    ++i; // skip past the illegal type that was encountered
171    for (; i < size; i++) {
172      final TypeMirror t = stl.get(i);
173      if (legalBeanType(t)) {
174        newTypes.add(t);
175      }
176    }
177    newTypes.trimToSize();
178    size = newTypes.size();
179    return
180      size <= 0 ?
181      BeanTypeList.of() :
182      BeanTypeList.of(this,
183                      newTypes,
184                      stl.interfaceIndex() >= size ? -1 : stl.interfaceIndex(),
185                      proxiable(newTypes.get(0), size));
186  }
187
188  /**
189   * Returns a non-{@code null}, determinate {@link BeanTypeList} of {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean
190   * types} that the supplied {@link TypeMirror} bears.
191   *
192   * <p>The returned {@link BeanTypeList} may be {@linkplain BeanTypeList#isEmpty() empty}.</p>
193   *
194   * @param t a non-{@code null} {@link TypeMirror}
195   *
196   * @return a non-{@code null}, determinate {@link BeanTypeList} of {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror) legal bean
197   * types} that the supplied {@link TypeMirror} bears
198   *
199   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code t} is {@code null}
200   *
201   * @see #supertypes(TypeMirror, java.util.function.Predicate)
202   */
203  public final BeanTypeList beanTypes(final TypeMirror t) {
204    final Domain d = this.domain();
205    return switch (t.getKind()) {
206    case ARRAY -> legalBeanType(t) ? BeanTypeList.of(this, List.of(t, d.javaLangObject().asType()), -1, false) : BeanTypeList.of();
207    case BOOLEAN, BYTE, CHAR, DOUBLE, FLOAT, INT, LONG, SHORT -> BeanTypeList.of(this, List.of(t, d.javaLangObject().asType()), -1, false);
208    case DECLARED, TYPEVAR -> {
209      final SupertypeList legalBeanSupertypes = this.supertypes(t, BeanTypes::legalBeanType);
210      yield
211        BeanTypeList.of(this,
212                        legalBeanSupertypes,
213                        -1,
214                        proxiable(legalBeanSupertypes.get(0), legalBeanSupertypes.size()));
215    }
216    default -> BeanTypeList.of();
217    };
218  }
219
220  /**
221   * Clears caches that may be used internally by this {@link BeanTypes}.
222   */
223  public final void clearCaches() {
224
225  }
226
227  private final ElementKind elementKind(final TypeMirror t) {
228    final Element e = this.domain().element(t);
229    return e == null ? null : e.getKind();
230  }

232  /*
233   * Static methods.
234   */
235
236  
237  /**
238   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link TypeMirror} is a <dfn>legal bean type</dfn> as defined by
239   * the <a href="https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#legal_bean_types">CDI
240   * specification</a>.
241   *
242   * <p>Legal bean types are, exactly:</p>
243   *
244   * <ol>
245   *
246   * <li>{@linkplain javax.lang.model.type.TypeKind#ARRAY Array} types whose {@linkplain ArrayType#getComponentType()
247   * component type}s are legal bean types</li>
248   *
249   * <li>{@linkplain javax.lang.model.type.TypeKind#isPrimitive() Primitive} types</li>
250   *
251   * <li>{@linkplain javax.lang.model.type.TypeKind#DECLARED Declared} types that <dfn>contain</dfn> no {@linkplain
252   * javax.lang.model.type.TypeKind#WILDCARD wildcard type}s for every interpretation and level of containment</li>
253   *
254   * </ol>
255   *
256   * @param t a non-{@code null} {@link TypeMirror}
257   *
258   * @return {@code true} if and only if {@code t} is a legal bean type; {@code false} otherwise
259   *
260   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code t} is {@code null}
261   *
262   * @spec https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#legal_bean_types CDI Specification, version
263   * 4.1, section 2.2.1
264   *
265   * @see <a
266   * href="https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CDI-502?focusedId=13036118&page=com.atlassian.jira.plugin.system.issuetabpanels%3Acomment-tabpanel#comment-13036118">CDI-502</a>
267   *
268   * @see <a href="https://github.com/jakartaee/cdi/issues/823">CDI issue 823</a>
269   *
270   * @see <a href="https://issues.redhat.com/browse/WELD-1492">WELD-1492</a>
271   *
272   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and deterministic.
273   *
274   * @microbean.threadsafety This method itself is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads, but {@link TypeMirror}
275   * implementations and {@link Domain} implementations may not be safe for such use.
276   */
277  public static final boolean legalBeanType(final TypeMirror t) {
278    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#assignable_parameters
279    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#legal_bean_types
280    return switch (t.getKind()) {
281
282    // "A bean type may be an array type."
283    //
284    // "However, some Java types are not legal bean types: [...] An array type whose component type is not a legal bean
285    // type"
286    case ARRAY -> {
287      if (!legalBeanType(((ArrayType)t).getComponentType())) { // note recursion
288        if (LOGGER.isLoggable(WARNING)) {
289          LOGGER.log(WARNING, t + " has a component type that is an illegal bean type (" + ((ArrayType)t).getComponentType() + ")");
290        }
291        yield false;
292      }
293      yield true;
294    }
295
296    // "A bean type may be a primitive type. Primitive types are considered to be identical to their corresponding
297    // wrapper types in java.lang."
298    case BOOLEAN, BYTE, CHAR, DOUBLE, FLOAT, INT, LONG, SHORT -> true;
299
300    // "A bean type may be a parameterized type with actual [non-wildcard, non-type-variable, see below] type parameters
301    // [arguments] and type variables." (A bean type may be a parameterized type whose type arguments are either array
302    // types, declared types, or type variables.)
303    //
304    // "However, some Java types are not legal bean types: [...] A parameterized type that contains [anywhere, see
305    // below] a wildcard type parameter [argument] is not a legal bean type."
306    //
307    // Some ink has been spilled on what it means for a "parameterized" (generic) type to "contain" a "wildcard type
308    // parameter [argument]" (https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CDI-502). Because it turns out that an "actual type" is a
309    // non-wildcard, non-type-variable type, it follows that *no* wildcard type argument appearing *anywhere* in a bean
310    // type's declaration is permitted. Note that this definition of "actual type" does not appear in the CDI
311    // specification, but only in a (closed) JIRA issue raised against the specification
312    // (https://issues.redhat.com/browse/CDI-502?focusedId=13036118&page=com.atlassian.jira.plugin.system.issuetabpanels%3Acomment-tabpanel#comment-13036118):
313    // "An actual type is a type that is not a wildcard nor [sic] an unresolved [sic] type variable."
314    //
315    // This still seems way overstrict to me but there you have it.
316    case DECLARED -> {
317      for (final TypeMirror ta : ((DeclaredType)t).getTypeArguments()) {
318        if (ta.getKind() != TYPEVAR && !legalBeanType(ta)) { // note recursion
319          if (LOGGER.isLoggable(WARNING)) {
320            LOGGER.log(WARNING, t + " has a type argument that is an illegal bean type (" + ta + ")");
321          }
322          yield false;
323        }
324      }
325      yield true;
326    }
327
328    // "A type variable is not a legal bean type." (Nothing else is either.)
329    default -> {
330      if (LOGGER.isLoggable(WARNING)) {
331        LOGGER.log(WARNING, t + " is an illegal bean type");
332      }
333      yield false;
334    }
335    };
336  }
337
338  /**
339   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link TypeMirror} is a {@linkplain #legalBeanType(TypeMirror)
340   * legal}, {@linkplain javax.lang.model.type.TypeKind#DECLARED declared}, <dfn>proxiable bean type</dfn> as defined by
341   * the <a href="https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable">CDI specification</a>.
342   *
343   * @param t a non-{@code null} {@link TypeMirror}
344   *
345   * @return {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link TypeMirror} is a <dfn>proxiable bean type</dfn>
346   *
347   * @exception NullPointerException if {@code t} is {@code null}
348   *
349   * @see #proxiableElement(Element)
350   *
351   * @spec https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable CDI Specification, version 4.1,
352   * section 3.10
353   *
354   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and deterministic.
355   *
356   * @microbean.threadsafety This method itself is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads, but {@link TypeMirror}
357   * implementations and {@link Domain} implementations may not be safe for such use.
358   */
359  public static final boolean proxiableBeanType(final TypeMirror t) {
360    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable
361    return
362      t.getKind() == DECLARED &&
363      legalBeanType(t) &&
364      proxiableElement(((DeclaredType)t).asElement());
365  }
366
367  /**
368   * Returns {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Element} is an {@linkplain ElementKind#INTERFACE
369   * interface}, or a <dfn>proxiable</dfn> {@linkplain ElementKind#CLASS class}, as defined by the <a
370   * href="https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable">CDI specification</a>.
371   *
372   * @param e a non-{@code null} {@link Element}
373   *
374   * @return {@code true} if and only if the supplied {@link Element} is <dfn>proxiable</fn>
375   *
376   * @excepiton NullPointerException if {@code e} is {@code null}
377   *
378   * @spec https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1unproxyable CDI Specification, version 4.1,
379   * section 3.10
380   *
381   * @microbean.idempotency This method is idempotent and deterministic.
382   *
383   * @microbean.threadsafety This method itself is safe for concurrent use by multiple threads, but {@link TypeMirror}
384   * implementations and {@link Domain} implementations may not be safe for such use.
385   */
386  static final boolean proxiableElement(final Element e) {
387    // https://jakarta.ee/specifications/cdi/4.1/jakarta-cdi-spec-4.1#unproxyable
388    switch (e.getKind()) {
389    case CLASS:
390      if (e.getModifiers().contains(FINAL) ||
391          e.getModifiers().contains(SEALED) ||
392          ((QualifiedNameable)e).getQualifiedName().contentEquals("java.lang.Object")) { // cheap optimization for a common case
393        return false;
394      }
395      boolean hasNonPrivateZeroArgumentConstructor = false;
396      for (final Element ee : e.getEnclosedElements()) {
397        switch (ee.getKind()) {
398        case CONSTRUCTOR:
399          if (!hasNonPrivateZeroArgumentConstructor &&
400              !ee.getModifiers().contains(PRIVATE) &&
401              ((ExecutableElement)ee).getParameters().isEmpty()) {
402            hasNonPrivateZeroArgumentConstructor = true;
403          }
404          break;
405        case METHOD:
406          final Collection<?> modifiers = ((ExecutableElement)ee).getModifiers();
407          if (modifiers.contains(FINAL) &&
408              !modifiers.contains(STATIC) &&
409              !modifiers.contains(PRIVATE)) {
410            return false;
411          }
412          break;
413        }
414      }
415      return hasNonPrivateZeroArgumentConstructor;
416    case INTERFACE:
417      return true;
418    default:
419      return false;
420    }
421  }
422
423  private static final boolean proxiable(final TypeMirror firstLegalBeanType, final int size) {
424    return
425      // Non-declared legal bean types cannot be proxied.
426      firstLegalBeanType.getKind() == TypeKind.DECLARED &&
427      ((DeclaredType)firstLegalBeanType).asElement() instanceof TypeElement e &&
428      (proxiableElement(e) ||
429       // Still potentially proxiable if the reason the firstLegalBeanType's element failed the
430       // #proxiableElement(Element) test was because the first non-interface bean type was java.lang.Object but we know
431       // that there are interfaces in this list.
432       e.getQualifiedName().contentEquals("java.lang.Object") && size > 1);
433  }
